clips.title: The story
paras: At his farm in Elwynn, Marshal Haggard has lost the badge he carried in Stormwind's service. Dead-tooth Jack stole it by trickery, and the Defias may use it to impersonate city officials.

Marshal Haggard retired to a small farmstead in the hills of Elwynn Forest, but his old Stormwind Marshal's badge still carries official weight. One night, Dead-tooth Jack, a Defias rogue, wore a Stormwind tabard and posed as Marshal Dughan, Goldshire's garrison commander. He tricked Haggard into believing his former peers needed the insignia for official business. The aging marshal handed it over without suspicion. Jack fled into the woods before Haggard saw through the ruse. In Defias hands, the emblem of Stormwind authority could let outlaws pass checkpoints or confuse local patrols.
